headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty snapped a two-day rally as IT stocks led a market sell-off.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 30 November.

why: Selling pressure in IT stocks dragged down benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty.
Profit booking kicked in after a brief two-day market recovery.
Brent crude oil prices topped $97, dampening investor confidence.
Broader demand concerns and global headwinds impacted equity markets.
whatHappening: On the last trading day, Sensex tumbled nearly 1,000 points while Nifty 50 closed below 25,650.
NIFTY50 and SENSEX ended their 4-week winning rally to close the week in the red.
Select microcap stocks such as Greaves Cotton and Thomas Cook posted gains of up to 50%.
Metal stocks outperformed during the session despite broader market weakness.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices snapped a two-day rally due to widespread selling in IT stocks and profit booking. Sensex crashed up to 1,000 points while Nifty slipped below 25,650 as crude oil prices surged above $97. TCS and select microcap stocks like Greaves Cotton showed strength despite the overall market decline.
